contribute.title: Contribute to the community library
contribute.lead: Every Prompt, Skill, Bot and Workflow is a file in the repo — contribute with a GitHub issue or pull request.
contribute.promptBody: A micro-prompt with {{VARIABLE}}s — JSON in content/prompts/.
contribute.skillBody: An agent SOP: inputs, tools, steps, quality gates.
contribute.workflowBody: A multi-step pipeline where each output feeds the next step.
contribute.viaPr: Or open a pull request directly
contribute.step1: Fork the repo and create a branch, e.g. content/add-linkedin-hook-prompt
contribute.step2: Add one file under content/prompts | skills | workflows | bots following CONTRIBUTING.md
contribute.step3: Run npm run validate && npm test — the validator blocks undeclared variables, duplicate ids and leaked secrets
contribute.step4: Open a pull request: the PR template has a checklist for a quick review
